readings.moment: Fräulein Lina came down into the kitchen
The temple struck eleven, after which Lina stayed in the kitchen until after it struck
When the hall clock struck eleven

durations: The kitchen clock runs 15 minutes fast of the temple bell (it showed 10:15 when the temple struck ten)
Madame's piano played for 13 minutes by the kitchen clock (from 10:48 to 11:01)
The kitchen clock was 3 minutes ahead of the hall clock when the hall clock struck eleven (11:03 vs 11:00)
Lina stayed in the kitchen from 10:37 by the kitchen clock until after the temple struck eleven
whereabouts: Rosa was in her kitchen from the evening until the end of the night
Lina came down into the kitchen at 10:37 by the kitchen clock
Lina stayed with Rosa in the kitchen until after the temple struck eleven
Lina sat by the stove in the kitchen
Madame was playing the piano (Chopin) from 10:48 to 11:01 by the kitchen clock
Rosa went up the stairs and along to the atelier to fetch the master
Rosa opened the atelier door and saw Monsieur on the floor by his bench
Rosa went down to Madame after the atelier
